verdict.rationale: Galileo is a SaaS evaluation and observability platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no evidence of an interactive or try-it API reference, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The cookbooks, quickstarts and SDK guides are tutorials, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
